## Environment

- Firmware and console model:
- Source revision and eboot/helper SHA-256:
- Host OS and tool versions:
- Exploit, loader, HEN and mount versions (unknown is acceptable):

## Reproduce

Describe the steps, expected behavior and observed behavior.
Distinguish TV observations, console logs and host-only checks.

## Evidence

Include a short filtered excerpt or a recording using the generated test clip.
Remove account identifiers, QR codes, LAN addresses, addon URLs and tokens.
Do not attach raw logs, private settings, console dumps or runtime modules.

## Recovery

Describe any close, relaunch, rollback or reboot that you performed.
